name: Cserdi (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Cserdi (a shield of red and blue with a ploughshare, a sprig of leaves and ears of grain) above a green scroll inscribed CSERDI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
